description: How TmModelingModelTree structures its elements (Fáze 12). The default Auto renders the ParentId hierarchy when at least one element resolves to a valid parent and keeps today's SemanticType groups for flat models, so a model without ParentId looks and behaves exactly as before. SemanticType is the pre-phase-12 flat grouping; Hierarchy always renders the nested APG tree built from ModelingElementDto.ParentId.
